description: Write a file inside your workspace (content up to 8 MiB). offset 0 (the default) replaces the file; a larger offset writes in place. Paths are inside the workspace: this tool never uploads local files. On a guarded fleet you must first ask the user and get their explicit agreement; only then set `confirm` to the fleet name.

confirm.description: Guarded fleets only: the fleet name, set only after the user explicitly agreed. Never set it on your own.

content.description: File content (at most 8 MiB once decoded).

context.description: Context name. Omit to use the default.

encoding.description: How content is encoded: text (default) or base64.

fleet.description: Fleet name. Omit to use the default.

mode.description: Permission bits for a new file (decimal, e.g. 420 for 0644).

offset.description: Byte offset to write at. 0 (default) replaces the file.

workspace.description: Workspace id. Omit to use this session's workspace on the fleet.

name: write_file
